name: Kai Berry
life: “I still remember cleaning a mirror that still held its dawn mist.” On Sunday, near the corner outside Coastal Barber, Kai usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I clean the mirrors on quiet mornings. I offered the widow those mornings before we decide who takes the glass.
appearance: Kai is easy to recognize by a center part and straight chestnut hair and heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw. Usually dressed in a soft blue checked shirt with one cuff folded back twice, Kai gives a little nod before asking a hard question when listening.
personality: Kai prefers exact instructions at work and pleasant surprises at home. The two standards occasionally collide, especially when a relative thinks dropping by counts as notice.
agenda: To open quiet mornings for private visits.
family: Edward Roy is Kai’s stepsibling. Kai is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Edward calls about good news first. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *The first language*, Edward says, “I once changed my name to make school easier.”
connections: Layla Colón. Morning cleaning gives the restorer a chance to explain the gray patch to the widow in private.

reactions.situation: Another customer asks for a last fitting in front of it
reactions.response: Kai sets aside an ordinary fitting time before making plans for the sale.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Kai asks which other bill repayment would displace, then offers only what the household can afford to give.
